* {{skill icon|Glimmer of Light}} ([[elite]])

==Hero Usage==
* Heroes use this spell on an ally as soon as that ally has lost as much health as Orison will heal for.

== Notes ==
* Orison of Healing is considered the most basic of healing spells with its low energy cost, cast time, recharge and lack of contingencies commonly found on other healing spells.

== Trivia ==
* The word orison means "prayer".
